description: Required placement date is required for target-date KPI reporting

Response deadline should not be after required placement date
Core weekly fee must not be negative
Total weekly fee must not be negative
Referral enrichment must have one row per referral
Derived offer count must be present and defaults to zero when no offer exists
Derived offer count must not be negative
Derived unique-home count must be present and defaults to zero when no offer exists
Derived unique-home count must not be negative
Derived estimated weekly cost must not be negative when supplied
Provider-observation flag must be present for every referral
First action cannot precede referral creation and excludes the creation event itself
First offer cannot precede the referral creation timestamp
Accepted offer cannot precede referral creation
Accepted-offer timestamp should not precede the first offer timestamp
IPA issue cannot precede referral creation
Referral closure cannot precede referral creation
Last activity cannot precede referral creation
IPA admission cannot precede the referral creation timestamp
IPA admission should not be before IPA issue
IPA signature should not be before IPA issue
IPA signature after planned placement admission requires review
An admitted placement without an eligible due-diligence review date requires review
Due-diligence review date must be after IPA admission
